parameters.name: Date
parameters.description: The date to query, in the format yyyyMMdd with a fixed length of 8 characters. Online data is retained for only 8 days. Dates beyond the retention period return an empty list.

parameters.name: SaseUserId
parameters.description:
The user ID. You can obtain this value from the following operations:
- [ListUserDevices](~~ListUserDevices~~): Lists user terminal devices.
- [GetUserDevice](~~GetUserDevice~~): Queries the details of a user terminal device.
